text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai has finally 
arrived. Fine Motion is cheerfully 
thrilled that her friend Daiwa Scarlet is 
also running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However,
she seemed to be making an effort 
to stay cheerful.
The Trainer tells her to 
forget everything during the race and
just have fun running...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion, however, cannot forget her 
own standing. Putting on her usual smile, 
she heads off toward the race...
